Now a saved full-source/serving-GGUF/decode identity witness must match before resume; old unclaimed outputs refuse retrospective identity, and duplicates and edited summary digests refuse.
acceptance_criteria: New evidence requires actual model output tied to the registered source; saved GGUF hash is a launcher witness, not cryptographic PID/loaded-weight proof. Frozen quality statistics and selection precedence were not modified.

description: Observer installed experts.forward as a closure strongly referencing experts, creating a cycle that could hold ~1.56-1.57 GiB live GPU layer tensors after del layer. It also allocated a destination copy while separately loading checkpoint GPU tensors. description: Four-arm plan previously accepted 20-step trainer templates and caller-selected estimated GPU hours against the frozen 1000-step, <=2.5GPUh-per-arm ceiling. Now exact steps, placement, BF16, model small-metadata identity, step/load receipt, evaluation reserve and timeout must match. description: Before the fix, REAP observer used calibration rows read at startup but recorded calibration_sha256 from an independent read after 40-layer execution. Changed bytes could falsely attribute activations to a different file. Current full-byte snapshot binds rendered rows and measured SHA, checks for changes before layer/final publication and refuses reuse of an existing output directory. 47 focused CPU tests on isolated commit and 215 selected integrated tests passed. No real 704-row D0 observation was launched.
acceptance_criteria: Exact-head CI and independent frozen model qualification remain separate.
